text: The purpose of this report is to request further instructions for the Ontario Land Tribunal hearing into this matter scheduled to commence on July 24, 2024, for 10 days. The applicant appealed the proposed Official Plan Amendment and Zoning By-law Amendment applications for 18 Portland Street and 1-9 Niagara Street (the "Development Site") to the Ontario Land Tribunal from Council's failure to make a decision on the applications within the prescribed time periods pursuant to the Planning Act. The Ontario Land Tribunal hearing is scheduled to commence on July 24, 2023 for 10 days. Given this timing, this item is urgent and cannot be deferred.

City Council on June 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2023) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (June 1, 2023) from the City Solicitor. 3. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 1, 2023) from the City Solicitor remain confidential at the discretion of the City Solicitor, as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege.
